about: Comparison rules that exactly one earlier golden pins, asked again in another place: a GENERAL PIP that fails, on the left or on the right, an absent key, an index past the end, null or a null body on the right, bare null on the right, a dot in a MATCH pattern, a boolean or object GENERAL body. Most cases put the condition of the golden in a DENY rule of a nested set under PERMIT_UNLESS_DENY: true when the rule does not apply or ends, false when it denies or the decision fails. Each case's about names the golden it seconds.

cases.about: Control: a DENY rule over a resource attribute that does not hold. True unless the stand answers every check with 400.
